+title: 'IntegrationTests: print the full wire trace when the subagent validator fails, and the last frames of each connection when a nested test times out'
+---
+## What
+FoundationModelsACPAgent ^4273b5t investigates the flaky nested tests of task 01M737WW16. The ACPAgent session asked for more data (2026-11-10). Today a failure prints only the violations of `SubagentWireTraceValidator`, and a timeout prints nothing about the wire.
+
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientIntegrationTests/AgentNestedScenarioTests.swift:60`: when `violations` is not empty, attach the full ordered trace to the failure (for example a `Comment` in the `#expect`, or `Issue.record` with the trace text). Each line has the position, the connection, the direction, the method, the session id and the update kind, so that the position numbers of the violations point to lines.
+- [ ] For `anOrderlyQuitResumesTheRunsAndCompletesTheOriginalAgentsCall` and `aKilledAgentResumesTheNestedRunWithItsTree`: keep a bounded buffer of the last frames (for example 50) of each connection, and record it when the test ends with an issue, also at the time limit. Use the existing wire recorder of the tests if there is one; do not add a second recorder.
+- [ ] The output goes to the test issue, not to stdout, so a passing run prints nothing more.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A forced validator failure (a test-local trace with an update before its announcement) records the ordered trace in the issue.
+- [ ] A passing run prints no trace.
+- [ ] When a nested test times out, its issue holds the last frames of each connection.
+- [ ] The commit goes to foundationmodelsacpagent-ec and testudoapp-75.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Add a unit test for the trace formatter: a small trace gives the expected lines with positions.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests` → it passes, except the known flaky tests of 01M737WW16.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1 #flaky
\ No newline at end of file
